title: Unable to purchase the Pro 20x plan
author: Beginning-Sign1916
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/10s37czjp0qh1.png?width=1255&format=png&auto=webp&s=e67f425c4f46e1198a1ad4743c0741729ecd7ea2

After doing tons of research and also testing on my Plus plan I have decided to go for the Pro 20x plan for a month to see how much can I get out of it consider a simple actual test run but then it was temporary unavailable. Question is for anyone here using it do you managed to get one proper game build out with assets designing using Astra and if so what is your actual cost/usage like? Cause right now I am going to try both Claude pro 20x for Fable and ChatGPT pro 20x for Astra and see which actually deliver with quality
